add.title: Add User

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.description: Protect your account with an extra security layer using Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Authy.
twoFactor.disabledHeading: Enhance your login security with TOTP
twoFactor.enabledHelp: You will be prompted for a 6-digit code or emergency backup recovery code upon login.
twoFactor.disabledHelp: Requires scanning a QR code with an authenticator app and keeping backup recovery codes.
twoFactor.setupDescription: Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Authy.
twoFactor.recoveryHelp: Save these codes safely. If you lose your authenticator app, each code can be used once to log in.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Enter a 6-digit code from your authenticator app or an emergency recovery code to confirm.

permissions.title: Access Control & Permissions

roleDescriptions.editor: Manages all content — can create, edit, delete, and publish.
roleDescriptions.contributor: Creates and edits content — cannot delete or publish.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Read-only access to the admin panel.

summary.title: Permission Summary
summary.description: Overrides configured for this role. Rows not listed here fall back to the wildcard default.
summary.empty: No overrides — using factory defaults for all content types.

matrix.title: Content Type Permission Matrix
matrix.description: Set allowed actions per role. The * row is the default for all content types. Override individual content types by toggling actions in their specific row. Greyed checkboxes are inherited from the wildcard row.

fields.title: Field-Level Access Control Matrix
fields.description: Restrict read visibility and write mutations for specific attributes (e.g., hide salary, margin, or internal notes from non-admin roles).
fields.emptyTitle: No fields defined for this content type
fields.emptyHelp: Add fields to this content type in the Schema Builder first.
fields.adminRead: Admin always has full read access
fields.adminWrite: Admin always has full write access

enforcement.title: Zero-Leak Security Enforcement:
enforcement.read: When a role is unchecked from Read Visibility, the backend automatically strips the field from all REST () and GraphQL responses before sending to the client.
enforcement.write: When a role is unchecked from Write Access, the backend rejects unauthorized mutation attempts with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

permissions.adminNote: Note: Admin always has universal access across all schema fields and cannot be restricted.
